visual_action: A montage of clips featuring Donald Trump. It begins with a silhouette of him overlaid with a sparkling firework effect. Subsequent clips show him in profile walking through a crowd, waving to a large audience, walking from behind wearing a red 'TRUMP' hat, and walking with a woman down a hallway. There are also shots of an airplane on a tarmac at dusk and him walking up the stairs to board it. The video includes a clip of him walking on a lawn, presumably at the White House. The video ends with black-and-white footage of the White House and Marine One helicopter, with the text 'THE WHITE HOUSE' overlaid.
